supporting_observations.claim: The failed logons target svc-grades from FILE-ORC-01, with source address 10.56.20.20 and incorrect-password status (0xc000006a).

The failures recur at roughly one-minute intervals, consistent with the stated GradeSync schedule of re-authenticating each run; the supplied failures start at 13:32, after the scheduled 13:30 password rotation.
The repeated failures are consistent with GradeSync continuing to authenticate with an outdated password after the scheduled rotation, rather than by themselves establishing malicious activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied authentication records stop at 13:47 UTC, before the end of the requested 14:20 UTC review window.
The evidence contains authentication outcomes but not GradeSync process logs or configuration showing whether and when its stored password was updated.
The records do not establish whether svc-grades authentication succeeded later in the review window.
claims_not_established: That the failed attempts were definitively generated by the GradeSync job; the cadence and context are consistent with it, but the supplied records do not identify that application as the source.
That the svc-grades password was updated in GradeSync after rotation.
That the separate explicit-credential event involving ops-agent caused or was connected to these failed logons.
additional_evidence_needed: If validating the benign explanation, check GradeSync logs and its stored-credential update time against the failed-authentication period.
Review authentication records through 14:20 UTC for subsequent successes or continued failures.
